lines.x: President Volodymyr Zelensky requested US authorization for Patriot interceptor missiles funded by allies after Russia launched 2,700 drones, 165 missiles, and 1,460 bombs across 20 Ukrainian regions in one week.
Russian missile strikes targeted three major bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing three people and injuring 15.
Russian attacks targeting Ukraine's electrical infrastructure have heightened international fears over power disruptions to nuclear power plants and potential radiation risks.
European leaders urged Russia to halt winter attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure while US officials signaled Moscow is becoming open to collective security models.
